vendor: Baker Hughes (Nuovo Pignone) and Siemens Energy (Dresser-Rand) reciprocating compressor product pages
scope: Published frame envelope limits for API 618 and API 11P / ISO 13631 reciprocating process compressors, used as physical upper bounds for reciprocating engineering inputs
usage_rule: Upper-bound evidence only. API 618 itself sets no numeric speed or piston-speed limit (Kopscick, Turbomachinery Symposium; API 618 para 2.2 'Allowable Speeds'), so frame envelopes come from manufacturers.

sources.document: Baker Hughes API 618 reciprocating compressors product page
Siemens Energy reciprocating compressors product page (ISO 13631 / API 11P)
Kopscick, API 618 moderate-speed compressors, Turbomachinery Symposium (TAMU OakTrust)

derived_bounds_for_c7b.basis: Baker Hughes API 618 cylinder size up to 1250 mm
Baker Hughes 1980 kN double-acting piston load
Siemens API 11P rated to 1500 rpm; high-speed gathering compressors run 1200-1800 rpm (USPTO 11781664 background)
Baker Hughes API 618 up to 800 bar; Siemens up to 10000 psig (690 bar)

derived_bounds_for_c7b.applies_to: reciprocating frame; a compression stage needs at least one cylinder, so stage count <= cylinders
derived_bounds_for_c7b.basis: SRC-BH-API618: modular design allows up to 10 cylinders per frame
